title: Fast-rising Micah releases the highly anticipated track "F'd It Up"
htmlContent:
Emerging artist Micah is a talented singer and songwriter taking over the industry with every enthralling drop. The super-talented artist does himself every outing with his latest release, "F'd It Up."

Micah's "F'd It Up" is a musical masterpiece that takes you on a journey you don't want to return. The track is a blend of super dope sounds that keeps all his fans on the high edge and keeps them returning for more.
